values.description: Postgres from the VPC (NLB and app)
Orders Postgres via NLB endpoint service

values.name: daily-events
values.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count() AS events FROM s3_events WHERE day >= {from:Date} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

values.name: Top event types
values.sql: SELECT event_type, count() AS n FROM s3_events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
